result.summary:
Design basis: keep the existing Node HTTP API, version-1 JSON file, and CLI readers. Add stored due on each ticket (created plus UTC hours for its priority at assignment), present due on HTTP only when DUE_TIMES is the string on, and list overdue as isActive and due < now ANDed after the existing matcher. Channel remains request/response; no queue, worker job, cache, or due notification. Crash during save still leaves the old file or the new file (existing rename). UI N/A (JSON API; CLI columns frozen). Ambition fallback: GUIDES/platforms/ui.md#light-expressive-starting-point unused because there is no human-facing surface.

Work queue: one item W1 covering R-5–R-13 and AD-1–AD-6 (R-1–R-4 preserved inside it). Split refused: persist without HTTP strip fails existing test/api.test.js body equality. Document/changelog is W1's document stage. No environment-prep item: local-test harness is ready. No deploy item: source-only (A8); OP-1 and OP-2 stay operator handoff.

Backchain route: navigator five-lens audit; did not spawn the source-aware-native Until Loop child (eight seed steps, contracts already in spec/architecture). Ran printed backchain-check on RUN/scratch/plan-backchain-candidate.json; receipt RUN/backchain/nav-c03f512203f2498d8ebc00c6f929a7c5/check-c817379b4cb2.json reports ok, complete, 8 steps, parallel groups [S1,S2,S4] then [S7,S8]. Internal suppliers: S1 config → S3 store; S2 persistence → S3; S4 query → S5 HTTP; S3+S5 → S6 wiring → S7 tests and S8 docs.

Assumptions A1–A10 all evidenced or probed; none open. A2 locked by spec.md. Architecture Structure gained Namespace and data (this plan); AD-1–AD-6 unchanged; no AD-7.

Preservation: existing tests unmodified; default flag-off omits due; VERSION stays 1; RAW_COLUMNS frozen; matchesFilters OR unchanged.
